faqPage.title: FAQs
faqPage.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.desc: Find answers to your questions about Buddy Review. Whether you're a brand looking for the right influencer or an influencer looking to monetize, we have the answers you need.
faqPage.contactUsPrompt: If you have more questions, you can

faqsBrand.q: What services does Buddy Review provide?
faqsBrand.a:
Buddy Review handles influencer marketing end to end, across Strategy & Intelligence, Creator Campaigns, Content & Production, and Commerce & Amplification — from analysing the brief and planning the strategy, finding and selecting influencers, and managing outreach and the work, to setting the content direction, overseeing production and publishing, and on to boosting, affiliate, live commerce, and reporting results against the agreed KPIs.
Brands can pick only the services they need, or have us run the whole campaign end to end.

faqsBrand.q: How is hiring an agency different from doing it yourself?
faqsBrand.a:
Working with an agency doesn't just save time finding and contacting influencers — it puts the whole process on a clearer system: setting the strategy, selecting creators that fit the brief, negotiating and managing the work, keeping content and timelines on track, and tracking and measuring the campaign.
Buddy Review combines data, technology, and our team's experience at every step, so the brand team spends less time coordinating and more time on the bigger picture, while the campaign stays on its objectives.

faqsBrand.q: How do you choose the “right” influencers?
faqsBrand.a:
We don't start by looking for the most famous influencer. We start with who the brand needs to reach, and which creators can genuinely take the brand to those people.
Buddy Review looks at creators across many dimensions — location, demographics, content category, occupation, persona, and storytelling — alongside our data-driven matching on engagement, unique follower overlap, content fit, and campaign history.
We then combine the data with our team's experience to find creators with audience fit, brand fit, and content fit — not just people in the same category or with the most followers.

faqsBrand.q: Can you find specialist or niche creators?
faqsBrand.a: Yes. Buddy Review has a database of more than 1 million creator profiles, sorted into more than 100 creator categories across many dimensions, so we can search from broad creator groups right down to niche creators that match a brand's specific brief and audience in much finer detail.

faqsBrand.q: What kind of influencers should we use, and how many?
faqsBrand.a:
No number or tier suits every campaign, because each group of creators plays a different role. Some campaigns need large influencers to build reach and awareness, while others suit many micro influencers or KOCs to build credibility, content volume, or reach across several smaller audiences.
Buddy Review designs the creator mix from your objective, audience, budget, and the role you need creators to play first, then sets the right number and proportions — instead of starting from how many influencers to use.

faqsBrand.q: Can you run a campaign aimed at sales or conversions?
faqsBrand.a:
Yes. Influencer marketing doesn't have to stop at reach or engagement. We can design campaigns that lead on to traffic, affiliate, live commerce, conversions, or amplifying content with paid media, to match the brand's objective and customer journey.
The team chooses creators, content formats, platforms, and how results are measured to fit the goal from the start, rather than using the same kind of influencer for every campaign.

faqsBrand.q: Which platforms can campaigns run on?
faqsBrand.a:
Buddy Review can plan and manage campaigns on many platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, X (Twitter), Lemon8, and Threads, as well as other channels that suit the audience and the campaign format.
We choose platforms based on audience behaviour, content format, and the brand's objective — a campaign doesn't need to use every platform.

faqsBrand.q: What can you measure after the campaign?
faqsBrand.a:
Clients can follow campaign performance in real time through Buddy Review's system, and when the campaign ends, the team reports results against the agreed KPIs and objectives — such as reach, views, engagement, traffic, or trackable conversions.
We can also prepare a report file in the format you need, to summarise results, analyse performance, and build on it for the next campaign.

faqsBrand.q: What does the campaign budget include?
faqsBrand.a:
The budget we propose is an all-inclusive price for the scope of work and services agreed, so the brand can plan its budget clearly.
If you'd like to add services or change the campaign format, just talk to the Buddy Review team — we're happy to advise and suggest further options that suit the brand's goals and budget.

faqsBrand.q: How long does it take from brief to campaign live?
faqsBrand.a:
Generally, Buddy Review takes about 2 weeks once the brief and campaign details are confirmed. The timing can vary with the format and complexity of the campaign.
If the brand has a schedule or a date it wants the campaign to go live, let the Buddy Review team know in advance so we can plan the timeline together to fit.

faqsBrand.q: Can we reuse the influencers' content?
faqsBrand.a:
Yes, content reuse can be planned, depending on the usage rights and the agreement with each creator — for example, posting it on the brand's own channels, using it in advertising, or amplifying it with media through Spark Ads and Partnership Ads.
Buddy Review can coordinate usage rights, duration, and how the content will be used from the planning stage, so the brand can build on the content for its goals rather than it living only on the influencer's channel.

faqsBrand.q: What kinds of businesses has Buddy Review worked with?
faqsBrand.a:
Buddy Review has run influencer marketing for brands across many industries, including Food & Beverage, Beauty & Personal Care, Pet Care, Finance & Insurance, Retail, Home Appliances, Entertainment & Events, and more.
We design the strategy and choose creators to suit consumer behaviour and each business's goal, whether that's brand awareness, a product launch, market expansion, community engagement, or sales conversion.
See real work and more on how we work in [Our Work](/success).

faqsBrand.q: How do I get started with influencer marketing with Buddy Review?
faqsBrand.a:
You can reach Buddy Review through the [Contact Us](/contact) page on our website, or ask the team directly:
Phone: [088-686-1676](tel:0886861676)
Email: [info@buddyreview.co](mailto:info@buddyreview.co)
Just share some basic details about your brand and goals, and the Buddy Review team will get back to you to talk it through and propose a campaign approach that fits your needs and budget.

faqsInfluencer.a:
Buddy Review is a platform that connects creators with brands, giving them the chance to work together on influencer marketing campaigns.
We've been in the industry for more than 9 years, worked with more than 1,000 brands, and run more than 4,000 campaigns. Whether you're just starting out as a creator or already experienced, you can sign up for the chance to work with brands that suit you.

faqsInfluencer.q: How is the pay for each campaign decided?
faqsInfluencer.a:
Pay at Buddy Review varies by campaign, based on the type of work, the type of content, and the brand's conditions, so it fits the work involved.
Creators can check the pay and campaign conditions before deciding to join, so you can choose the jobs that suit you.

faqsInfluencer.q: I've signed up — why haven't I received any jobs yet?
faqsInfluencer.a:
After signing up with Buddy Review, you may not receive a job right away, because each campaign has its own requirements and influencer selection criteria, depending on how well your profile fits and the audience the brand wants to reach.
We recommend completing your profile, connecting your social media channels, and keeping your information up to date, so brands can get to know you better and you have a better chance of getting jobs that suit your channel.

faqsInfluencer.q: I don't have many followers — can I still sign up as a reviewer?
faqsInfluencer.a:
Yes, you can. Each campaign has different selection criteria, and it isn't only about follower count — your audience, content type, and fit with the brand matter too.
We recommend completing your profile to improve your chances of getting campaigns that match you.

faqsInfluencer.q: Is it free to sign up for Buddy Review?
faqsInfluencer.a: Signing up as a reviewer with Buddy Review is free. Just register and complete your profile to start receiving opportunities to join campaigns from different brands.

Buddy Review pays on a schedule that depends on how you take on work:
• Reviewers redeeming points in the system: paid on the 20th of the month. Redeem your points and submit all related information by the 20th.
• Companies, juristic persons, or work taken on through a quotation: paid on the 7th of the following month. Submit the work and all documents by the 7th.
Late information or documents may move you to a later payment round, and if a payment date falls on a holiday, payment moves to the next business day.

faqsInfluencer.q: Do I need to connect my social media accounts?
faqsInfluencer.a: We recommend connecting all your social media accounts so the system can pull your stats and match you with suitable campaigns. If you have trouble connecting an account, contact the team on [LINE: @buddysupport](https://line.me/R/ti/p/@buddysupport).

faqsInfluencer.q: I've received a campaign notification — what should I do?
faqsInfluencer.a: When you get a campaign notification, you can check the brief, type of work, pay, and conditions for joining. We recommend reading all the details before deciding to join the campaign.

faqsInfluencer.q: I've joined a campaign — what do I need to do?
faqsInfluencer.a: Reviewers need to complete the work according to each campaign's brief and conditions — such as creating content, reviewing a product, or posting on social media — and submit it following the set steps and deadlines so the team can check it.

faqsInfluencer.q: I got a notification, so why hasn't the money arrived yet?
faqsInfluencer.a:
Your bank may send an email or SMS about the transfer before the money shows in your account. Check the date and time stated in the message from Kasikornbank.
If that time has passed and you still haven't received the money, contact the team on [LINE: @buddysupport](https://line.me/R/ti/p/@buddysupport) so we can look into it.

faqsInfluencer.q: What documents do I need to receive payment?
faqsInfluencer.a:
The documents you need depend on how you're paid:
• Individual reviewers: a copy of your national ID card and a copy of your bank account book page.
• Companies or juristic persons: a copy of the ID card, a copy of the VAT registration certificate (Por.Por.20), and a copy of the company's bank account book page.
Please check your details and send every document to avoid payment delays. Juristic persons must also send the original receipt or tax invoice within 7 days of receiving payment.

faqsInfluencer.q: Is there a fee for redeeming points?
faqsInfluencer.a:
Redeeming points for cash has a transfer fee of 8 THB per transaction. You can redeem from 2,000 points (200 THB) upward, at a rate of 10 points = 1 THB.
Example: redeeming 2,500 points gives 250 THB; after the 8 THB fee, 242 THB is paid into your account.

faqsInfluencer.q: I forgot my email or can't log in — what should I do?
faqsInfluencer.a: Contact the team on [LINE: @buddysupport](https://line.me/R/ti/p/@buddysupport) with your account name and details of the problem, and we'll check and help you log in.

successStories.tagline: From foodies to gamers, Buddy Review made Nissin a hit across all generations.
paras: Nissin launched a fun online campaign featuring influencers with diverse styles, creating mouth-watering content that went viral.

Nissin introduced its new 'Spicy Tom Yum Cheese' flavor, combining the bold taste of Thai Tom Yum with the smooth richness of cheese for a unique and tempting experience. Buddy Review designed and planned a campaign to reach every segment—from movie buffs and gamers to foodies and lifestyle enthusiasts. We engaged influencers ranging from Nano to Mega KOLs in the Foodie, Gamer, and Lifestyle categories, and created snackable content that is easy to watch, quick to enjoy, and visually memorable with melting cheese, blowtorched cheese, and onsen eggs to trigger immediate cravings.

successStories.tagline: Fast-turnaround KOL & KOC Campaign

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review managed sourcing KOLs and KOCs for DAP Double Booster within a fairly tight campaign period. The brief wasn't just about speed — the team also had to find creators who suited the product and could produce review content that felt natural, at the same time. The team had to run both creator selection and coordination within 3 days to keep everything on the campaign's timeline.

sections.heading: The Challenge
sections.body:
3 days, but creator quality still had to hold up. With a fairly short timeframe, finding KOLs/KOCs had to happen fast, while still checking each creator's fit with the product.
We focused on people who could talk about the product naturally and had a content style suited to beauty/skincare reviews. The goal was content that felt as close as possible to each creator's own channel, within the set period.

sections.heading: Creator Selection
sections.body: Choosing people whose reviews would feel natural. For DAP Double Booster, the team selected both KOLs and KOCs who could talk about the product in their own voice. Sample content covered angles like everyday product use, caring for dark spots, melasma, and freckles, or talking about the ingredient and results after use — bringing the product into a review format close to the beauty content these creators already made.

sections.heading: KOL & KOC Approach
sections.body:
The campaign split creator use into both KOL and KOC.
KOL Content — used KOLs with a large follower base to help build reach and engagement for the campaign.
KOC & Additional Creator Content — used another group of creators to add more reviews and produce content that felt closer to real, everyday use.
Using both groups together let the campaign have both reach-driving content and naturally styled review content.

sections.heading: Fast-turnaround Execution
sections.body: From brief to content within 3 days. Another key point of this case was speed of execution. The team was able to source KOLs/KOCs and run the work within the campaign's 3-day period. Under a tight timeline, every step had to move fairly quickly — from finding the right creators to preparing content to go live on schedule.

sections.heading: Content Direction
sections.body:
Most of the content spoke about DAP Double Booster through the lens of skincare, such as:
• Dark spots
• Melasma, freckles, and dark marks
• Tranexamic Acid
• Texture and how to use it
• Experience after using the product
This kept each piece of content within a beauty/skincare context, staying true to the format each creator already used to communicate with their own followers.

successStories.takeaway: DAP Double Booster is a case that had to balance two things at once: moving fast enough to meet the campaign's period, and choosing creators who could still review the product naturally. The team used both KOL and KOC to deliver reach, engagement, and review content within a fairly tight timeline. What stands out about this case is fast turnaround and natural creator content happening together within a single campaign.

successStories.tagline: Boosting LDC's clear aligner services with strong buzz and a trip to England giveaway.
paras: LDC Dental, a leading dental clinic in Thailand, partnered with Buddy Review to promote its clear aligner (Invisalign) services and launch a campaign that blended creative marketing with social value through carefully selected influencers.

Buddy Review selected influencers that matched the brand in both the health and family categories to create highly accessible service reviews. We also designed interactive activities offering a chance to win tickets to watch a football match in England, driving massive audience engagement.

successStories.tagline: Combining influencers and local content to elevate Viu in the hearts of the Isan people.
paras: Viu, a leading Asian streaming platform, collaborated with Buddy Review to create the 'Isan Watch Viu' campaign. This initiative brought the classic outdoor cinema experience to the Isan region while introducing popular series dubbed in the local Isan dialect. This approach effectively reached and built strong connections with the local target audience, making the campaign not just entertaining but also a powerful brand communication tool.

Buddy Review focused on utilizing local influencers to establish credibility and convey the event experience through engaging video content. We supported the creation of highly shareable content that perfectly captured the unique style of each influencer.

successStories.tagline: ENO and Guss Damn Good teamed up to create a new ice cream flavor called 'After Meal'.
paras: ENO, everyone's favorite post-meal effervescent powder, stepped beyond its traditional boundaries for a highly refreshing campaign. This time, ENO didn't just come in a sachet—it came with a flavor that told a story and an experience everyone wanted to try and talk about.

This campaign utilized an Influencer Marketing strategy with Buddy Review by selecting foodies, comedians, and creative influencers. This made the content fun, engaging, and told the flavor story in a unique way, generating excellent talkability on social media.

successStories.tagline: Igniting brand buzz with an event inspired by a viral series.
paras: AHC, a Korean skincare brand, hosted a highly creative event, 'AHC Skin Game THE T-SHOT', inspired by the hit Netflix series 'Squid Game'. This innovative brand promotion experience was designed specifically to attract younger audiences and series fans.

Buddy Review planned the strategy by bringing in top-tier influencers, amplifying the impact with PR from leading media outlets, and tailoring the content for each platform. We also monitored results in real time to ensure the campaign's success and viral reach.

successStories.tagline: Reaching koi keepers with precision, while expanding awareness at scale.

sections.heading: Campaign Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review planned the full Influencer Marketing campaign for Optimum Hi Pro — from strategy and key message to influencer selection — to build awareness among koi keepers while communicating the product's strengths clearly and reaching a wider audience.

sections.heading: Challenge
sections.body:
The brand's target audience is highly niche, so finding influencers who genuinely reach koi keepers required looking well beyond follower counts.
At the same time, the campaign still needed to deliver reach at scale while staying precisely on target.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.body:
Under the key message "Number One in Every Koi Keeper's Heart," Buddy Review built a creator strategy that blended two influencer roles.
Specialist influencers reached the koi-keeping community directly and built credibility, while lifestyle influencers extended awareness to a broader audience.
This let the campaign achieve both relevance and scale at the same time.

sections.heading: Content & Execution
sections.body:
Influencers delivered the key message through content suited to their own style — educational tips, fish-keeping techniques, product recommendations, and real usage experiences.
The campaign produced 37 pieces of content across TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and Lemon8, with TikTok as the primary channel.

successStories.takeaway:
Choosing influencers who match the target audience doesn't limit a campaign's reach — as long as each influencer group is given a clear role.
Blending specialist and lifestyle influencers let Optimum Hi Pro reach its core target of koi keepers while expanding awareness at scale, driving reach 114% above commitment and engagement 91% above the estimated KPI.
Plan your influencer marketing campaign with Buddy Review — we handle everything from strategy and influencer selection to content direction and measurement, so every step connects and delivers on your brand's business goals.

successStories.tagline: Building an Always-on TikTok Content Engine

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
Buddy Review managed end-to-end short-form content production for Auntie Anne's on TikTok — from storyboard development and talent sourcing to the production team — while continuously adapting content formats to keep pace with TikTok trends.
The engagement ran continuously for more than 15 months, at a cadence of roughly 15 contents per month, totaling over 225 contents across the partnership.

sections.heading: Challenge
sections.body: Running an always-on TikTok presence takes more than a steady volume of content — each piece has to stay fresh against fast-moving platform behavior and trends, all while staying true to Auntie Anne's brand character.

sections.heading: Content Insight
sections.body:
On TikTok, the content formats that capture attention can shift at any time. Sticking to one content formula risks the channel losing its freshness.
What matters isn't just "following trends" — it's having a system that can continuously catch trends → adapt storytelling → produce content → learn from performance.

sections.heading: Strategic Approach
sections.body:
Buddy Review built an Always-on Content Engine combining three elements: consistent posting cadence, content formats that adapt to trends, and a production system that could turn ideas into short videos in practice.
From developing and pitching storyboards, to matching the right talent to each piece of content, to sourcing and managing the production team — the channel could keep producing continuously without being tied to any single format.

sections.heading: Execution
sections.body: Produced roughly 15 TikTok contents per month, covering content planning, storyboard development, talent sourcing, and video production — with direction and format continuously adjusted to trends as they emerged.

successStories.takeaway:
This shows that an effective always-on TikTok presence doesn't come from hoping every clip goes viral — it comes from building a content system that produces consistently, adapts quickly to trends, and gives the right content room to grow through organic reach.
Across more than 15 months of continuous work, Buddy Review's role went beyond video production alone — helping build a TikTok content system that could evolve alongside the platform and audience interest.

successStories.tagline: India Influencer Campaign

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review brought Siangpure to Indian consumers through Indian influencers based in India on Instagram, framing the content angle so the product connected naturally with Thailand-travel behavior.

sections.heading: Challenge
sections.body: The brief wasn't just about finding overseas influencers — it required making a Thai product resonate with Indian audiences' interests, with enough reason for people to remember it or want to buy it when they visit Thailand.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.body:
Buddy Review selected Indian influencers whose audiences matched the target market, developing content under the concept "Visiting Thailand — what's the must-buy souvenir?"
This repositioned Siangpure from a Thai herbal product into a Thai Travel Essential — easy to carry, genuinely useful, and worth buying to bring home.

successStories.takeaway:
With just 3 influencers, the campaign generated a reach of over 333K — showing that choosing the right creators and aligning content with the target audience's behavior can drive results without needing a large roster of creators.
This case shows that cross-market influencer marketing isn't just about finding creators in that country — it's about finding the content context that lets the brand genuinely fit into the target audience's behavior.

successStories.tagline: Building a Year-round KOL & Friend of Brand Strategy

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review built a year-long influencer marketing strategy for Bobbi Dog to communicate consistently with dog owners throughout the year. The plan combined a network of 81 dog-focused KOLs for product reviews and content on TikTok and Facebook Page, together with a Friend of Brand who served as the brand's main storyteller over the long term.

sections.heading: Strategic Approach
sections.body:
From Campaign-based to Year-round Communication
Rather than communicating through creators on a one-off, campaign basis, Buddy Review structured the work as a full-year plan, letting Bobbi Dog spread its communication across multiple creator groups while having a lead character to build continuity for the brand.
The strategy was split into two main parts:
• KOL Network — 81 dog-focused KOLs creating product reviews and content on TikTok and Facebook Page
• Friend of Brand — a creator with a distinct character chosen as the brand's lead face, producing content continuously each month and extending into other content and activity formats

sections.heading: KOL Strategy
sections.body:
Connecting Bobbi Dog with Dog-focused Creators
Buddy Review selected KOLs whose content focused directly on dogs, so the product would be presented in an environment that matched the target audience and each channel's content style.
Across the year plan, 81 creators took part, spreading communication through:
• TikTok
• Facebook Page
Each creator presented the product through their own content style, letting the brand communicate through many creators and communities throughout the campaign.

sections.heading: Friend of Brand
sections.body:
Building Continuity with “Noppo”
Beyond distributing content through the KOL network, Buddy Review also brought in a Friend of Brand to create a lead character who could connect with Bobbi Dog continuously.
The team chose “Noppo,” a channel with a distinct character, as the Friend of Brand, producing content with Bobbi Dog every month throughout the campaign.
Noppo's role wasn't limited to product reviews — it extended into content and brand activities in several formats.

sections.heading: Content Collaboration
sections.body:
Noppo x Bobbi Dog
The collaboration between Noppo and Bobbi Dog went beyond monthly review content. One of the content collaborations was creating the song “Noppo x Bobbi Dog,” letting the brand enter a content format more closely tied to the creator's character.
The Friend of Brand relationship also extended from online content into an offline experience, with participation in one event.
This meant the creator's role spanned Monthly Content → Music Collaboration → Event Activation.

sections.heading: Campaign Structure
sections.body:
Throughout the year plan, Buddy Review managed the work across these key components:
• 81 Dog-focused KOLs creating product reviews and content on TikTok and Facebook Page
• 1 Friend of Brand using Noppo as the lead figure for long-term brand communication
• Monthly Content produced continuously with the Friend of Brand every month
• Music Collaboration developing the song Noppo x Bobbi Dog as one of the campaign's content collaborations
• Event Activation extending the Friend of Brand from online content to participation in one event

successStories.takeaway: Bobbi Dog's year plan shows influencers being used in two distinct roles. On one hand, scale was built through a network of 81 KOLs that put the product into content across a wide range of dog-focused channels. On the other, continuity was built through a Friend of Brand who produced content with the brand continuously, extending from monthly content into music collaboration and an event. Rather than relying on a single creator format, the plan connected both KOL Network and long-term creator collaboration together under one year plan.

successStories.tagline: Creating Buzz for a New Scent Through the Right KOLs

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: For Boots' S&G Let's Get Tropical campaign, Buddy Review managed KOL usage to build awareness for the product's new scent, selecting creators who fit the brand's image, the product, and the campaign's mood. One part of the approach was sending the product to 60 KOLs to try beforehand, letting creators experience the product firsthand and build a relationship before moving into reviews during the campaign.

sections.heading: KOL Selection
sections.body: Choosing people who fit the product and the campaign's mood. The campaign used multiple KOL groups to help bring S&G Let's Get Tropical to the target audience through a range of perspectives. This included KOLs who acted as brand and product representatives, such as Mo Jiratchaya and Namhom, as well as other creators whose character and content style suited the product — letting the new S&G scent be presented through creators with different styles and storytelling approaches, while still connecting back naturally to the overall Boots campaign.

sections.heading: Product Seeding
sections.body: Before reviews began, the product was sent to 60 KOLs to try for real. This step gave creators the chance to get to know both the product and the scent before creating content, while also helping build the relationship between Boots, S&G, and the creators ahead of communication during the campaign.

sections.heading: Content Rollout
sections.body: Campaign content was distributed across multiple channels, including TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram. Each creator took the summer/tropical mood and told it through their own style — from beach travel angles, to skincare, to their experience with the Let's Get Tropical scent — giving the campaign a range of content formats while staying under the same mood.

successStories.takeaway: The heart of this campaign was building awareness for S&G Let's Get Tropical under Boots through KOLs suited to both the product and the campaign's mood. From sending the product to 60 creators to try firsthand, to selecting KOLs with a character that fit the product, to distributing content through a range of creator formats — this helped the new scent be told through multiple perspectives and build awareness naturally during the campaign.

successStories.tagline: KOL Planning Across the Event Journey

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review helped shape the campaign strategy for CP ALL Education Forum 2026, mapping KOL roles to each phase of the event. From promoting the event and joining onsite, through to recommending KOLs suited to speak on stage.

sections.heading: Campaign Strategy
sections.body: Matching KOLs to each stage of the event. Each phase of the event called for a different KOL role. The team planned everything from KOLs suited to promoting the event, to KOLs who could join onsite, and those suited for a speaker role. This meant KOL selection was built into the campaign strategy from the start.

sections.heading: KOL Roles
sections.body:
• Promote the Event — Planning KOLs to help communicate and promote CP ALL Education Forum 2026
• Join Onsite — Placing KOLs to attend the event in line with the campaign plan
• Recommend Speakers — Recommending KOLs suited for a speaker role at the event

successStories.takeaway: CP ALL Education Forum 2026 is another case where we designed KOL roles to align with each phase of the event. From driving awareness to onsite participation and stage appearances, all under one campaign strategy.

successStories.tagline: Reaching Mom & Family Audiences Through Macro–Celebrity Creators

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review managed sourcing Macro–Celebrity level mom-and-baby influencers for the D-nee Mild & Care 2026 campaign on TikTok, to review and communicate the product to each creator's own follower base.

sections.heading: Challenge
sections.body: The campaign's challenge was selecting mom-and-baby influencers with a Macro–Celebrity level audience size and an image suited to presenting the D-nee Mild & Care product.

sections.heading: Creator Selection
sections.body: Buddy Review sourced 18 influencers, focusing on creators whose content centered on mothers, children, family, and lifestyle. The creators involved had a wide range of follower sizes, from the tens of thousands up to the millions, letting the campaign present the product through many different creator formats.

sections.heading: Content Execution
sections.body: All content was published as video on TikTok, with each creator conveying the product in a different context suited to their own content style — from fragrance and gentleness, to caring for a child's clothes, a mother's daily life, and lifestyle and everyday use within the family.

successStories.takeaway: The D-nee Mild & Care campaign shows the use of Macro–Celebrity level mom-and-baby influencers to bring the product into the different everyday content and contexts of each creator. Rather than communicating the product through a single format, the campaign's content appeared across multiple contexts — from mother and child, to family, to lifestyle — letting the product be presented through creators with different storytelling styles.

successStories.tagline: Making Air-con Content Easier to Relate To

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review partnered with Hakuhodo Bangkok to manage the influencer campaign for Daikin — from strategy and creator selection through to tracking campaign results. The key challenge was communicating air-conditioner information, technology, and energy-saving benefits through creators who could bring these topics into a context audiences could easily understand and relate to.

sections.heading: Creator Approach
sections.body:
Matching each creator to the story they were best suited to tell.
The campaign brought together technical creators with air-conditioner expertise alongside creators who could connect the product to everyday life, producing content from multiple angles — from explaining compressors, inverter technology, and how to choose an air-conditioner, to relatable topics like electricity bills during the hot season.

sections.heading: Turning Product Information into Content
sections.body: One of the best-performing pieces of content came from tackling the topic of electricity costs from running an air-conditioner, told through a simple, relatable angle. Rather than opening with technical product details alone, the content led with a familiar, everyday issue before connecting it back to Daikin and its energy-saving benefits. At the same time, technical creators added another dimension, speaking about the product and its technology from their own professional experience and expertise.

sections.heading: Multi-format Content
sections.body: The campaign produced 26 pieces of content across multiple formats, including short video, Facebook content, YouTube, and Instagram. This let each topic be presented in the format best suited to both the product story and the creator delivering it.

successStories.takeaway: For products with a lot of technical detail, choosing influencers isn't just about follower count. What matters more is who can make the product easy to understand, credible, and connected to what audiences already care about. Daikin is another case where specialist creator knowledge and everyday, relatable storytelling worked together to communicate the product within a single campaign.

successStories.tagline: Turning Product Benefits into Stories of Care

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: For Fineline Mild & Care, Buddy Review helped shape the content direction by using “a mother's care” as the core theme for communicating the product, rather than starting directly from the fabric softener's features. The content brought viewers into stories of family, the mother-child relationship, and small moments at home, before connecting back to Fineline. The campaign was designed to build broad awareness while also driving Add to Cart.

sections.heading: Content Strategy
sections.body:
Letting the story carry the product into everyday life. The campaign's content spanned formats including morality dramas, family stories, and moments from a mother's perspective.
Captions ranged from teaching children and tips from mothers, to simple everyday topics like clothing, fragrance, and caring for family members — connecting product benefits like fragrance, softness, and gentleness to stories audiences could immediately relate to.

sections.heading: Family Storytelling
sections.body:
One of the directions was using mothers and family as the storytellers, such as:
• Teaching children
• Tips from mothers
• Care shown through clothing care
• Family moments at home
The product became part of the story as an element of care, rather than being presented as a direct product demonstration.

sections.heading: Content Rollout
sections.body: The campaign produced 14 pieces of content across a range of creators and content formats — family stories, mother-and-child content, and content speaking directly to Fineline Mild & Care's features — letting the same message be told across multiple situations while staying under the theme of “care.”

successStories.takeaway: What set the Fineline case apart was using emotional storytelling to carry the product benefits. Fragrance, softness, and gentleness weren't told as product information alone, but placed within the story of caring for family — letting the brand build both awareness and feeling with viewers through content closer to everyday life.

successStories.tagline: Turning a Teaser into Social Buzz

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review managed the celebrity and KOL lineup for Mega Halloween 2025, building buzz for the event from launch onward. The campaign opened with War Wanarat shooting the event's teaser, which was warmly received by fans and trended on X on the day it dropped. KOLs suited to the campaign then followed, helping more people discover the event while it was happening.

sections.heading: Creating the First Buzz
sections.body: Opening with a moment worth talking about. The campaign began by having a celebrity launch the event. The teaser drew attention to Mega Halloween from the very start, earning praise from fans and generating buzz on social media on launch day.

sections.heading: KOL Campaign
sections.body: After sparking buzz with the teaser, the team brought in KOLs to keep promoting the event. KOLs were used to expand awareness of the event throughout the campaign, with the KOL Campaign portion delivering 2.8M Reach and a CPR of 0.1.

sections.heading: From Social to Event
sections.body: Mega Halloween drew strong attention on social media, along with a large turnout at the event itself. The campaign connected the dots from the launch moment all the way through to KOLs helping sustain buzz throughout the event.

successStories.takeaway: Mega Halloween built momentum in stages. It started with a celebrity teaser to capture attention at launch, before handing off to KOLs to expand awareness of the event in the following phase.

successStories.tagline: Building a Year-round Creator Strategy Across Platforms

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review built a year-long influencer strategy for Mom Choice, using the brand's character as part of how creators were selected. We worked with KOLs from the “sai dua mae” (boss-mom persona) group who matched the Mom Choice concept and name, as well as creators running cat-focused channels — 169 creators in total — to produce product reviews and content continuously throughout the year. Content was distributed across multiple platforms, from TikTok, Facebook Page, and X to Lemon8, letting creators tell the product story in the format and community that suited each channel.

sections.heading: Creator Strategy
sections.body: From brand name to creator character — one of the plan's core ideas was interpreting “Mom Choice” beyond just the product name. We selected both “sai dua mae” creators with a distinct character and cat-focused creators whose audience was already centered on pets, letting each one tell the product's story in their own style rather than using a single, uniform review format.

sections.heading: Multi-platform Approach
sections.body: This year plan didn't limit creators to a single platform, but spread content according to each channel's strengths — from short-form video on TikTok, content on Facebook Page, conversation on X, to content on Lemon8 — letting Mom Choice reach cat owners across multiple content formats.

sections.heading: Content Learning
sections.body: A key learning from the campaign was that letting creators tell the product story in a way that blended naturally with their own content style tended to perform better than a direct-sell approach. Each platform also played a different role, so there was no need to use the same format or storytelling approach across every channel.

successStories.takeaway: Mom Choice's year plan didn't start from the question of “how many influencers do we need” alone, but from which type of creator fit the brand's character and which platform that content should run on. This let the plan combine creator fit, scale, and multi-platform content together throughout the year.

successStories.tagline: Turning a Familiar Brand into a New Beauty Story

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Most people know SCOTCH for its “bird's nest drink,” but this time the brand extended bird's nest into a skincare mask. The campaign's challenge was making the new product easy to understand and worth trying, while still connecting back to the bird's nest image people already knew. Buddy Review used both review content and promotional content to introduce the SCOTCH Bird's Nest Mask and bring the product into a beauty & skincare context.

sections.heading: Communication Idea
sections.body: From a familiar bird's nest to a beauty product no one had seen before. The product's novelty was used as the starting point for the story, before introducing the bird's nest mask, its ingredients, how to use it, and promotions — turning what people already knew about the brand into a reason to be interested in this new product category.

sections.heading: Review Content
sections.body: Review content explained what the SCOTCH Bird's Nest Mask actually is, through the lens of beauty creators and review pages. The content covered the bird's nest ingredient, its formulation, how to use it, and post-use experience, helping a fairly new product for the brand become clearer to understand.

sections.heading: Promotion Content
sections.body: Another part of the campaign used promotion-focused pages to communicate the product's offers, including the 11.11 campaign and a 1-for-1 promotion at Lotus's — meaning the communication didn't stop at introducing what the product is, but also created moments that encouraged consumers to actually try buying it.

sections.heading: Two Campaign Waves
sections.body:
The campaign was communicated across 2 waves, with both review content and promotion content playing their part
• Product Introduction & Review — building understanding and interest in the bird's nest mask as a new product from SCOTCH
• Promotion Push — using promotions and sales windows to help drive interest in the product

successStories.takeaway: What makes this case interesting is using SCOTCH's existing brand familiarity to open the door for a new product category. Rather than introducing the bird's nest mask as an unfamiliar skincare product, the content started from what people already remembered about SCOTCH, before leading into the product, how to use it, and promotions — turning familiarity with “bird's nest” into interest in the “bird's nest mask” within the same campaign.

successStories.tagline: Turning Fandom into Campaign Awareness

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review managed the KOL campaign to promote the SmartHeart x PROXIE set, using both creators with large followings and creators from the fandom community to help expand the campaign's reach to a wider audience. Content was distributed across multiple platforms — X, TikTok, and Facebook Page — so the campaign could reach the spaces each community was already using and talking in.

sections.heading: KOL Approach
sections.body:
Reach New Audience Through the Right Communities
One of the campaign's strengths was using KOLs with large followings to distribute content to a new audience and build reach for the campaign. At the same time, KOLs from PROXIE's fandom connected the campaign with a community that was already invested, so the content didn't just drive visibility — it also sparked conversation and interaction around the campaign.

sections.heading: Multi-platform Communication
sections.body: The campaign used KOLs across X, TikTok, and Facebook Page to build awareness through different content formats and user behaviors on each platform. This let SmartHeart x PROXIE spread the campaign message across multiple communities at once, using each KOL's character and following to help expand reach.

successStories.takeaway: The SmartHeart x PROXIE case shows that reach and interaction can work together. KOLs with large followings carried the campaign to a new audience, while the fandom group drove conversation and engagement with the content. Spreading the communication across multiple platforms helped the campaign build awareness across several areas of the target audience.

successStories.tagline: One KOL, Different Platform Strengths

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review managed the Teepol campaign through a single KOL, bringing the product into content in a style the audience was already familiar with, and publishing it across multiple platforms. The content connected Teepol to cooking, dishware care, and kitchen cleanliness — in line with the “Krua Yai Ning” (Grandma Ning's Kitchen) character.

sections.heading: Challenge
sections.body: The campaign's challenge was bringing the product into the KOL's content without making the brand message feel disconnected from the main content or too much like a direct sell. At the same time, each platform has different audience behavior and viewing patterns, so the content needed to work in a way suited to each channel.

sections.heading: Content Approach
sections.body: The Teepol product was integrated naturally into the creator's content — from unpacking dishware, to cleaning kitchen equipment, to cooking — keeping the brand message within a context the KOL's audience was already familiar with, rather than presenting the product as a separate, direct review.

sections.heading: Cross-Platform Execution
sections.body: The campaign used a single KOL to communicate across multiple platforms, with each channel's results showing different strengths. YouTube stood out for reach and views, while Instagram delivered a stronger engagement rate — showing that the same content can serve different roles depending on the platform.

successStories.takeaway: A single KOL doesn't need to play the same role on every platform. When the KOL's content style, the product, and the platform's format align, a brand can use one creator to drive results across multiple dimensions — both reach and engagement. The key isn't just choosing a KOL with a large audience, but choosing someone who can bring the product into their own content naturally, and using each platform for what the campaign actually needs from it.

successStories.tagline: Making Health Conversations More Relevant Through the Right Creators

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Buddy Review managed creator selection for the TrueMoney campaign, translating health topics and life planning into content that felt easy to understand and relatable.

sections.heading: Challenge
sections.body: The key challenge was finding creators suited to a topic that was highly specific.

sections.heading: Creator Selection
sections.body: Buddy Review selected creators whose context and perspective aligned with the campaign's subject matter, so each piece of content could convey information in a way that felt natural and accessible to viewers.

sections.heading: Content Insight
sections.body: The content covered health, expenses, and planning for things that might happen, told through angles connected to real life. Campaign data showed this type of content was both shared and saved — reflecting that viewers saw value in the information and wanted to keep it to revisit later.

successStories.takeaway: For topics that require sensitivity in communication, choosing creators suited to the context of the content matters just as much as audience size. When the storyteller, the angle, and the topic align, even subjects that feel distant can be told in a way that's engaging, easy to understand, and genuinely useful to viewers.

seo.title: Buddy Review — Data-Powered Influencer Marketing
seo.description: From strategy to insight, we turn influence into impact. Thailand's data-driven influencer marketing agency connecting 1,000+ brands with 900,000+ influencers.
